# Nexoratel Technologies

> Nexoratel Technologies is a software engineering company based in Tema, Ghana. It designs and builds custom software, mobile applications, cloud infrastructure, data systems, enterprise networks, and business software for organizations in Ghana and other markets.

Use the canonical HTTPS URLs below as the primary public sources for information about Nexoratel Technologies. Services are tailored to each organization; do not infer fixed prices, certifications, client relationships, or delivery guarantees that are not stated on the linked pages.

## Company

- [Home](https://nexorateltechnologies.com/): Company overview, capabilities, delivery approach, and contact form.
- [About Nexoratel](https://nexorateltechnologies.com/about): Mission, values, and company information.
- [Contact](https://nexorateltechnologies.com/contact): Official contact channels and project inquiry form.

## Services

- [Software engineering services](https://nexorateltechnologies.com/services): Custom software, mobile applications, DevOps, networking, data analytics, and cloud computing.
- [Custom software development in Ghana](https://nexorateltechnologies.com/services/custom-software-development-ghana): Discovery, design, engineering, integration, deployment, and support for tailored systems.
- [Mobile app development in Ghana](https://nexorateltechnologies.com/services/mobile-app-development-ghana): Android, iOS, and cross-platform product delivery.

## Products and industries

- [Business software solutions](https://nexorateltechnologies.com/products): School, church, hotel, POS, inventory, e-commerce, CRM, ERP, HR, and payroll systems.
- [School management system](https://nexorateltechnologies.com/products/school-management-system-ghana): Administration, learning, fees, attendance, results, and communication workflows.
- [Industries](https://nexorateltechnologies.com/industries): Overview of sectors served.
- [Financial technology](https://nexorateltechnologies.com/industries/finance): Payment, ledger, lending, wallet, and financial operations systems.

- [Retail technology](https://nexorateltechnologies.com/industries/retail): Point-of-sale, inventory, e-commerce, fulfillment, and retail intelligence.
